11.name: Marcus confesses the deposit lie
11.description: Marcus reveals that the promised deposit money was never in the account he claimed and admits Claire discovered the lie two days earlier.
evidence: Marcus's second sentence, when it came, was the truth he had not prepared: that the deposit money had never been in the account he'd promised it from, that Claire had found out two days ago

11.name: Marcus admits he delayed the truth
11.description: Marcus explains that he spent nine days believing he could rearrange things quickly enough to keep the lie temporary.
evidence: he had spent the nine days believing he could move pieces around fast enough to make the lie temporary

11.name: Asha withholds immediate response
11.description: Asha listens without interrupting and says she will call back in an hour instead of responding right away.
evidence: Asha listened all the way through without interrupting, and when he had finished she said only that she would call back in an hour.

11.name: Asha waits in tense silence
11.description: After ending the call, Asha lingers in the kitchen as the unanswered Bridgepoint hold continues and no one provides a number.
evidence: She set the phone on the counter, kept her shoulder against the laminate a moment longer, and let the kitchen go quiet around the fact that Bridgepoint's noon hold was still running and no one on the call had offered a number.

11.name: Asha weighs the transfer amount
11.description: Asha studies the marked-up rate sheet and her bank app, realizing the gap between the savings balance and the needed amount is smaller than she has admitted all week.
evidence: On the table behind her, the rate sheet Rosa had marked up sat next to her own bank app, still open to the savings line she had not touched in four years; the cursor blinked over the transfer field as if waiting for her to admit what she had already decided to consider.

Asha slid her thumb across the blinking cursor in the transfer field, her eyes moving from the savings line to the figure Rosa had circled twice on the rate sheet, and the gap between the two numbers was smaller than she had let herself see all week.

11.name: Asha initiates the wire transfer
11.description: Asha sits at the laptop, enters the full deposit amount, and authorizes a wire to Bridgepoint without adding a memo.
evidence: She stayed against the laminate a moment longer, listening to the refrigerator, then crossed to the table and sat down in front of the laptop.
She typed the full deposit into the field, read it back once, and authorized the wire to Bridgepoint without writing anything in the memo line.

11.name: sit down at laptop
11.description: She sits down in front of the laptop to carry out the transfer.
evidence: sat down in front of the laptop

11.name: enter full deposit amount
11.description: She types the full deposit amount into the transfer field.
evidence: She typed the full deposit into the field

11.name: authorize wire transfer
11.description: She reviews the amount and authorizes the wire to Bridgepoint without adding a memo.
evidence: read it back once, and authorized the wire to Bridgepoint without writing anything in the memo line

11.name: ignore confirmation reference
11.description: She sees the confirmation reference number but does not copy it down.
evidence: The confirmation screen came up with a reference number she did not bother to copy down

11.name: realize savings are committed
11.description: She realizes that four years of untouched savings have now been committed to the next phase of her life.
evidence: she understood, sitting there with the rate sheet under her wrist, that the four years of untouched savings had just become the shape of the next part of her life

11.name: accept Marcus's share as fixed
11.description: She decides Marcus's half is now just a number she will carry without discussing it again.
evidence: Marcus's half was now a number she would carry without asking him about again
